plugins.name: Vimm.net
plugins.author: BlizzHacker
plugins.description: Searches a browser-captured Vimm catalogue, imports entries with a public download action, and launches entries with Play Online in Vimm's hosted player.
plugins.terms: Vimm hosts mixed game content. The catalogue records only controls the source page presents to the user's browser. The provider does not grant redistribution rights; operators are responsible for using downloads and hosted play in accordance with applicable law and the source's terms.
plugins.comments: The companion Manifest V3 extension builds a local checkpointed catalogue and can add instant Vimm search, play, and download actions to any operator-approved hosted library origin. The ROM Hub provider is frontend-neutral and supports RomM, Gaseous, Retrom, LaunchBox-oriented workflows, ROMarr, Yarr.it, and other consumers of the RPP v1 interface.
